description: Hand-annotated evaluation set for WSD__Net: 10 ambiguous nouns x 6 sentences. 'gold' lists every WordNet 3.0 synset that is an acceptable answer - WordNet splits some senses very finely (e.g. three separate 'fish' senses of bass), so a prediction counts as correct if it is any synset in the list. 'sense_group' is a short human name for the meaning.
